positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Worked under the Test Fixture Engineering team to develop front-end GUIs using C#/XAML and C++ that helps manufacturers test their equipment/hardware to verify it is working properly
•	Updated and improved on existing software programs which are now used by the QA team to run tests on reference cartridges inside a Stat Profile Prime Analyzer and determine if the cartridge is usable for hospitals
•	Created a test application GUI using C++ in CrossStudio/WindowsBuilder for a LPC1788 LCD that runs a touch/screen test for manufacturers to see if there are any missing or dead pixels
•	Utilized Eclipse and C++ to create a battery monitor application for a Hospital Point-to-Care meter that measures current, voltage, and more

positions.title: Systems & Test / Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Performed Unit Tests of Software code using Ceedling and VectorCast program
•	Prepared and executed Software Tool Validation tests and prepared Software Design Verification Protocols
•	Conducted Smoke Tests to release interim Software builds for the team
positions.insights: Software Validation, Unit Testing and +1 skill

positions.title: Test Development Engineer
positions.locationName: North Reading, Massachusetts, United States · On-site
positions.description:
•	Created a fixture that connects to a E8460A 256-Channel High-Density Reed Relay Multiplexer by soldering wires together and inserting them into two 128-pin vertical connectors
•	Programmed the fixture using C# in Visual Studio to detect if a relay needed to be replaced and implemented command line arguments for the user such as stop-on-fail, logging, and more
•	Utilized C# to create a GUI that allows the user to replace a log file that contains a failed test with only passing data to shorten test times drastically
